article.zh: 钓鱼是我特别喜爱的一项运动。

article.en: I often fish for hours without catching anything.
article.zh: 我经常一钓数小时却一无所获。

article.en: But this does not worry me.

article.zh: 有些垂钓者就是不走运。

article.en: Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and rubbish.
article.zh: 他们往往鱼钓不到，却钓上来些旧靴子和垃圾。

article.en: After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
article.zh: 我总是在河上待上整整一上午，然后空着袋子回家。

article.en: 'You must give up fishing!' my friends say. 'It's a waste of time.'
article.zh: ‘你可别再钓鱼了！’我的朋友们说，‘这是浪费时间。’

article.en: But they don't realize one important thing.
article.zh: 然而他们没有认识到重要的一点。

article.en: I'm not really interested in fishing.
article.zh: 我并不是真的对钓鱼有兴趣。

article.en: I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!
article.zh: 我感兴趣的只是独坐孤舟，无所事事！
